name: premiere-pro
description: Plan, execute, verify, and export video edits in Adobe Premiere Pro through the Premiere Pro MCP server.

interface.shortDescription: Edit, inspect, and export Premiere Pro projects
interface.longDescription: Control an open Adobe Premiere Pro project with safety-oriented workflows for rough cuts, timeline changes, dialogue cleanup, captions, project inspection, and delivery exports. The plugin connects Codex to the local Premiere Pro MCP server and its CEP bridge.
defaultPrompt: Inspect my open Premiere project and summarize its current edit
Build a rough cut from the selected media
Verify this sequence and export the final deliverable
